name: novacart-refund-policy-v1
description: Twelve questions about the NovaCart refund policy. Ten are answerable from the document; the last two are not, and a correct system refuses them.

cases.question: How many days do I have to return a normal item?
cases.expectedAnswer: 30 days from the date the courier marks the parcel as delivered.
cases.relevantSource: Most items may be returned within 30 days of delivery. The 30 days are counted from the date the courier marks the parcel as delivered.

cases.question: What is the return window for a large appliance?
cases.expectedAnswer: 15 days, because of the cost of collection.
cases.relevantSource: Large appliances and furniture have a 15 day return window, because of the cost of collection.

cases.question: I am a NovaCart Plus member. How long do I have to return a large appliance?
cases.expectedAnswer: 30 days. A large appliance has a 15 day window and Plus adds 15 days.
cases.relevantSource: NovaCart Plus members get an extra 15 days on top of whatever window applies to the item. A Plus member therefore has 45 days on an ordinary item and 30 days on a large appliance.

cases.question: How long does a refund to a credit card take to appear?
cases.expectedAnswer: 5 to 7 business days after the refund is issued.
cases.relevantSource: Debit or credit card: 5 to 7 business days

cases.question: Can I return swimwear?
cases.expectedAnswer: No. Swimwear is final sale and cannot be returned except for a manufacturing fault.
cases.relevantSource: The following are final sale and cannot be returned or exchanged under any circumstances except a manufacturing fault: Innerwear, swimwear and pierced jewellery

cases.question: If I change my mind, do I get the delivery fee back?
cases.expectedAnswer: No. The delivery fee is refunded only when the return is NovaCart's fault: faulty, wrong or damaged.
cases.relevantSource: The original delivery fee is refunded only when the return is caused by NovaCart: a faulty item, a wrong item, or a damaged parcel. For a change of mind, the delivery fee is not refunded.

cases.question: Is there a pickup fee if I change my mind about a 300 rupee item?
cases.expectedAnswer: Yes, 49 rupees is deducted from the refund, because the item is under 500 rupees and it is a change of mind.
cases.relevantSource: For a change of mind on an item under 500 rupees, a pickup fee of 49 rupees is deducted from the refund.

cases.question: How quickly must I report a damaged parcel?
cases.expectedAnswer: Within 48 hours of delivery, with photographs of the packaging and the item.
cases.relevantSource: Report a damaged parcel within 48 hours of delivery, with photographs of the packaging and the item.

cases.question: I paid with loyalty points. How am I refunded?
cases.expectedAnswer: In loyalty points, not cash, and the points keep their original expiry date.
cases.relevantSource: Items bought with loyalty points are refunded in loyalty points, not cash. Points returned this way keep their original expiry date.

cases.question: I ordered from outside India. Who pays return shipping if the item is faulty?
cases.expectedAnswer: The customer pays return shipping in all cases on international orders, including faulty items.
cases.relevantSource: Orders shipped outside India have a 21 day return window and the customer pays return shipping in all cases, including faulty items.

cases.question: How long is the manufacturer warranty on a NovaCart laptop?
cases.expectedAnswer: I don't know based on the available documents.

cases.expectedAnswer: I don't know based on the available documents.
